SiteVisitExpense.title: SiteVisitExpense
SiteVisitExpense.description: Represents an employee's expense record for a site visit.

id.description: Unique identifier for the SiteVisitExpense entity.

employeeName.description: The full name of the employee who incurred the expense.

companyName.description: The name of the company associated with the site visit.

fromLocation.description: The starting location of the site visit route.

toLocation.description: The destination location of the site visit route.

goingAmount.description: Monetary amount spent on travel for the outgoing leg.

returnAmount.description: Monetary amount spent on travel for the return leg.

quotationReferenceNumber.description: Reference number for the associated quotation.

remarks.description: Additional notes for the site visit expense.

visitDate.description: The date when the site visit took place.

UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Represents a user's profile and assigned role within the system.

email.description: The email address associated with the user profile.

role.description: The access level assigned to the user.

Quotation.title: Quotation
Quotation.description: Represents a technical proposal or quotation generated for a client.

quotationId.description: Unique identifier for the quotation record.

clientDetails.description: JSON string containing name, companyName, and address.

products.description: JSON string representing the array of selected product line items.

pricing.description: JSON string representing the unit pricing for each line item.

totals.description: JSON string containing subTotal, totalGst, and grandTotal.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the quotation was generated.

createdBy.description: The UID of the administrator who generated the quotation.

status.description: The lifecycle status of the quotation.

subject.description: The primary subject line of the technical proposal.
